ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Tolstoy's pairs are kept distinct: «настоящее» (nastoyashcheye, 'real') and «истинное» (istinnoye, 'true') art against «поддельное» (poddel'noye, 'counterfeit') and «ложное» (lozhnoye, 'false') art; «блудница» (bludnitsa) is 'harlot' and «проститутка» (prostitutka) 'prostitute'. The website draft's dropped «полового» (polovogo, 'sexual') is restored, and in Ruskin «стрекоза басни» (strekoza basni, 'the dragonfly of the fable', Krylov's figure) is kept.
